Definition: {to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)}
BiblicalUsage: Yeçaph is the Aramaic word for adding, for increasing what is already there. Nebuchadnezzar says his reason returned to him, and excellent majesty was added to him when his kingdom was restored.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God adds majesty to the humbled king, and Nebuchadnezzar's restoration is His doing.
